_comment: The shop package's rights, shipped as a library layer (docs/commerce_PRD.md §4.10). They name only its own types and
only @authenticated: no slot, so no application has to bind anything. Products, variants and shop orders are
organization-owned (X8): Organizations' row rule narrows each right to the members of the owning organization (Viewer
reads, Member creates and edits, Admin deletes and publishes), so the right alone shows a signed-in user nothing of
another seller. Categories are edited by platform admins only (ManageSellers/Commerce, ShopCategoryInterceptor). Shop
orders are read-only: the shop writes them from order and shipment events. Reviews are NOT granted here (they are not
organization-owned): an application grants QueryRead/ShopProductReview to its moderators if it wants them in the
generic pages; buyers and moderators use /spark/commerce/shop/reviews*. The storefront reads published products through
/spark/commerce/shop/products and /catalog (anonymous). Opt out of all of these with "libraries": { "commerce-shop": false }.
